_doc: Arena v2 match views (Founder decision 2026-11-22). Display only: vision is derived from the event log's positions and never feeds the simulator (rules A1, R7). Distances are in ground units (the map is 1 unit north to south). vision: radius per kind of source. mask: the fog texture's cells per side and how often it is redrawn per real second. chase: event priorities (higher wins), the minimum time on one event and the idle time after a drag before the camera chases again, in real seconds. overview: the fixed whole-map camera of Field and All, and how much bigger tokens, bars and labels are drawn there.
